subject: MAP: POC environment preflight — API keys, org setup, allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Alice Ramos <alice@acme.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC preflight checklist and target dates

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. As we discussed, we want to lock down the mutual action plan so engineering can get the POC environment running next week. High-level asks from our side: 

- Org setup: create tenant for MedTech Solutions and a scoped service account.
- API keys: short-lived developer keys for staging + one production-like key for smoke tests.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide a limited set of CIDRs, need confirmation of firewall rules and expected propagation window.
- VPC peering: our infra team will request peering; need your guidance on routes/CIDR and any required support tickets.

Proposed timeline (rough):
- Wed May 7: org & service account created, initial API keys handed to us (staging).
- Thu May 8: IP allowlist added and sanity tests run.
- Fri May 9: VPC peering request submitted by us and validated by Redwood.

Can you confirm owners for each task and whether Redwood needs any additional artifacts (network diagram, SOC/attestation) to unblock?

Attached: initial MAP template (blank) — feel free to populate.

Best,
Alice Ramos
Head of Cloud Integrations
MedTech Solutions

[Attachment: medtech_map_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Ramos <alice@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-06T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC preflight checklist and target dates

Hi Alice — thanks, this is clear and a good start. Quick confirmations and a couple of requests from our side: 

- Owners: Priya (me) will own the MAP coordination and ticketing; Karthik on infra/peering; Neha on security/compliance artifacts.
- API keys: we'll generate two credential types: ephemeral dev keys (30m TTL) for engineers, and a longer-lived test key for the smoke suite (rotation schedule documented).
- Org setup: please provide the account admin email you want added as org owner and a preferred tenant name.
- IP allowlist: send the CIDRs you plan to use (one per line). We typically push firewall changes within 2–4 hours but allow up to 24 hours for propagation across our edge fleet.
- VPC peering: Karthik, note that MedTech will submit the peering request. We may need an internal support ticket for route propagation if they use custom BGP.

I attached our MAP template and filled the first row with owners and the proposed dates you mentioned. If those dates look tight for your team, call them out and we'll slide.

Action items we need from MedTech to unblock:
1) Account admin email (for org owner)
2) CIDR list for allowlist
3) Annotated network diagram (public/private subnets + NATs)
4) SOC2 summary or an attestation PDF for the security team review (if available)

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for tomorrow at 10am PT to go through open items.

— Priya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_map_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Alice Ramos <alice@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-06T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC preflight checklist and target dates — technical notes

Hi team — a few technical clarifications from infra so MedTech can prepare: 

- VPC CIDR overlap: please confirm MedTech's VPC CIDR(s). We recommend a /16 or /20 depending on services; avoid 10.0.0.0/8 if you expect future peering multiplexing.
- NAT/egress: if you need outbound control (for license callbacks or telemetry), let us know and we can provide egress static IPs to include in your allowlist.
- Peering specifics: our peering model is classic one-way acceptance. MedTech should initiate from their side and include our peer ID: rwfd-peer-3421. Once accepted we'll verify routes. Expect 1–2 business days for full routing verification unless both sides coordinate BGP.
- API keys & KV cache: for the longer-lived test key, we'll scope rate limits to avoid noisy neighbors on shared stacks; provide expected tokens per minute and we can size to a small reserved pool if needed.

Known blocker: SOC2 summary — Neha, once we have the doc we can pre-authorize specific roles.

Karthik
Senior Infra PM, Redwood Inference

[No attachments]

Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@medtech.solutions>
Date: 2025-05-07T08:22:00-07:00

Priya, team — attaching the requested network diagram and our SOC2 summary extract.

Answers to your requests:
- Org admin: ben.turner@medtech.solutions (Ben Turner) — please provision as org owner.
- CIDRs we plan to use (staging): 10.12.0.0/20, 10.13.0.0/20
- We're OK with your suggested timeline; will submit the peering request once we receive the peer ID from Karthik.

Quick question: are there any specific header or TLS requirements for the API keys when used from our VPC endpoints? Our security team typically locks down mTLS on egress to third-party APIs.

Thanks — attaching: medtech_network_diagram.png and soc2_summary.pdf

Best,
Alice

Thanks everyone — summary and agreed next steps (finalizing MAP):

1) Org & tenant creation — Owner: Priya N. — Due: 2025-05-07 17:00 PT — Status: DONE (provisioned tenant medtech-staging.redwood)
2) Provision API keys (dev ephemeral + test key) — Owner: Priya / Security — Due: 2025-05-07 18:30 PT — Status: DONE (credentials shared via secure vault link)
3) IP allowlist insertion — Owner: Karthik (actioned by Redwood infra) — Due: 2025-05-08 11:00 PT — CIDRs added: 10.12.0.0/20, 10.13.0.0/20 — Status: DONE
4) VPC peering verification — Owner: Karthik / MedTech netops — MedTech to initiate peering, Karthik to accept and verify routes — Target: 2025-05-09 end of day — Blocker: none yet
5) Security review (SOC2 attestation) — Owner: Neha Kapoor — Due: 2025-05-09 — Status: in progress (SOC2 extract received)

Notes on mTLS: we do not require mTLS for the POC keys; TLS 1.2+ with standard certificate validation is sufficient. If MedTech requires mTLS we can provide an alternate endpoint and an mTLS onboarding checklist (this will add ~2 business days).

Related links and artifacts: redwood_map_template.xlsx (completed), medtech_network_diagram.png, soc2_summary.pdf. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-1724

If no objections, I'll mark the MAP row as "in-flight" and hand off the peering verification to Karthik tomorrow morning.

— Priya
